mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 5 trading days signals imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend falls below 0.03 in any 12-month rolling window or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 or Rank IC for UNRATE threshold falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's expected policy tightening causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through increased real interest rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL threshold falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in industrial production over the past 5 trading days indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO trend falls below 0.03 in any 12-month rolling window or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during declining INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 700,000 units, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances when HOUST < 700 or Rank IC for HOUST threshold falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment and rises in unemployment indicate severe labor market deterioration, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial expansion regimes (INDPRO > 1.0% month-over-month), sustained manufacturing growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >40% of instances when INDPRO > 1.0 or Rank IC for INDPRO threshold falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
